'''Wakae Shrine''' (わかえじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Gifu|Q45798|qid=Q45798}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Gifu|af|Gifu-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Gifu|ar|غيفو (محافظة)|arz|جيفو (محافظه)|az|Gifu prefekturası|azb|قیفو اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Gifu|be|Гіфу (прэфектура)|bg|Гифу|bn|গিফু প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Gifu|cdo|Gifu-gâing|ce|Гифу (префектура)|ceb|Gifu-ken|ckb|پارێزگای گیفو|cs|Prefektura Gifu|cy|Gifu (talaith)|da|Gifu-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Gifu|eo|Gubernio Gifu|es|Prefectura de Gifu|et|Gifu prefektuur|eu|Gifu (prefektura)|fa|استان گیفو|fi|Gifun prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Gifu|frr|Gifu (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Gifu|gl|Prefectura de Gifu|hak|Gifu-yen|he|גיפו (מחוז)|hr|Gifu (prefektura)|hu|Gifu prefektúra|hy|Գիֆու (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Gifu|ilo|Prepektura ti Gifu|it|Prefettura di Gifu|ja|岐阜県|jv|Préfèktur Gifu|ka|გიფუს პრეფექტურა|kn|ಗಿಫು (ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯ)|ko|기후현|lt|Gifu prefektūra|lv|Gifu prefektūra|mk|Гифу (префектура)|mni|ꯒꯤꯐꯨ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|गिफू प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Gifu|ne|गिफु|nl|Gifu (prefectuur)|no|Gifu (prefektur)|nov|Gifu Prefekture|os|Гифу (префектурæ)|pam|Prepektura ning Gifu|pl|Prefektura Gifu|pnb|ضلع گیفو|pt|Gifu|ro|Prefectura Gifu|ru|Гифу (префектура)|se|Gifu prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Gifu|simple|Gifu Prefecture|sk|Gifu (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Гифу|su|Préféktur Gifu|sv|Gifu prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Gifu|tg|Префектураи Гифу|th|จังหวัดกิฟุ|tl|Prepektura ng Gifu|tr|Gifu (prefektörlük)|tt|Гифу (префектура)|uk|Префектура Ґіфу|ur|گیفو پریفیکچر|vi|Gifu|war|Gifu (prefektura)|wuu|岐阜县|zh|岐阜县|zh_classical|岐阜縣|zh_min_nan|Gihu-koān|zh_yue|岐阜縣|qid=Q131277}}. It is the Shikinaisha of {{ill|Katagata district|Q11504366|qid=Q11504366}}, {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}.

The {{ill|Ilex rotunda|Q844306|qid=Q844306}} and {{ill|Castanopsis|Q1065400|qid=Q1065400}} trees in the precincts are designated preserved trees of Gifu City<ref>{{Cite web|和書|date=2010-03 |url=http://www.city.gifu.lg.jp/secure/7161/hozonnjyu21.3.pdf |title=保存樹・保存樹林一覧表 |format=PDF |publisher=岐阜市 |accessdate=2013-04-26}}</ref>.

=== Overview ===
*The founding period is unknown. It is said to have originally stood about 1 km west of the current site, and was relocated because of flooding.
*In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it was called Wakamiya Hachimangū.
*When it was made a gōsha in {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5), it was renamed Wakae Shrine.
*The current shrine building was rebuilt in {{ill|1916|Q2087|qid=Q2087}} (Taishō 5).
